long_description:
Join Rohit for a high-energy Bollywood choreography experience celebrating Salman Khan! One song, one crew, unforgettable moves!

About this Event

Get ready for a high-energy Bollywood dance experience with Rohit!
Inspired by the charm, swag, and iconic moves of Salman Khan, Janam Samjha Karo is a group choreography experiment where we come together to dance, create, and become one crew.
This isn't just a drop-in workshop – you're part of the crew! Come bring your energy, learn the choreography, and be part of something exciting.
📅 November 12, 2026 (Thursday)
⏰ 7:30 PM – 9:30 PM
📍 Abhinaya School of Dance, Leander, TX
🎟️ $28 per person
One song. One crew. Let's make it unforgettable!
Presented by Agni Foundation for the Arts.
